hypothesis: Prior-only rolling behaviour of Q80 per-number families contains information about the next target's Q7 whole-quintet formula-universe rank quality beyond Q7's own rolling rank-quality baseline.
estimand: Forecast the target-level mean normalized percentile across the fixed 1,023 Q7 quintet-scoring formulas. This is a meta-quality outcome for the formula universe, not a direct prediction of winning numbers or an expected hit count.

join_contract.source_window_rule: For Q7 targets through 2026-10-24, only Q80 C0 ledger rows strictly before the target index may enter predictors.
join_contract.split_policy: Use the Q7 ledger split as authoritative. Do not compare Q80 C0 split labels because C0 and Q7 have different target-universe lengths and therefore different 60/20/20 split boundaries.

outcome.name: q7_mean_percentile_all
outcome.definition: Mean normalized percentile rank of the realized quintet across all 1,023 Q7 formulas on that target; 0.5 is the random-quintet reference.

definitions.q80_roll50_equal_family_top5_hits: Mean equal-family Top-5 hit count over the previous 50 Q80 targets.
definitions.q80_roll50_family_dispersion: Population standard deviation across the six family-specific mean Top-5 hit counts, each computed over the previous 50 Q80 targets.
definitions.q80_roll50_family_entropy_normalized: Shannon entropy of the six non-negative rolling family mean Top-5 hit counts, normalized by log(6).
definitions.q80_equal_family_recent25_minus_previous: Mean equal-family Top-5 hits over the most recent 25 prior Q80 targets minus the preceding 25 prior Q80 targets.

q7_only_ridge.role: Primary baseline model using only prior Q7 target outcomes.

cross_granularity_ridge.role: Augmented model testing incremental transfer from Q80 per-number behaviour into Q7 quintet-rank quality.

models.estimator: Ridge regression with intercept; features standardized on training rows only; alpha=1.0 fixed; intercept unpenalized; predictions clipped to [0,1].
models.tuning: No hyperparameter tuning, feature selection, or model selection after registration.

walkforward.discovery_prequential_training: At each Discovery target, fit using only earlier Discovery rows with valid features; minimum 50 training rows.
walkforward.frozen_model_fit: At end of Discovery, fit both models on Discovery rows with valid features (offsets 50..1971).
walkforward.validation_and_blind: Freeze model coefficients after Discovery. Update rolling predictor state only with outcomes from targets strictly before the current target; do not refit coefficients in Validation or Blind OOS.
walkforward.target_order: Build predictors from prior rows, predict current Q7 mean percentile, then reveal current Q7 outcome to future rolling state.

primary_endpoint.name: blind_oos_mae_improvement_cross_granularity_vs_q7_only
primary_endpoint.definition: MAE(q7_only_ridge) minus MAE(cross_granularity_ridge); positive values favour cross-granularity transfer.

inference.primary_test: One-sided block sign-flip test on paired absolute-error improvement.
inference.confidence_interval: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap of paired absolute-error improvement.
inference.multiplicity: One confirmatory primary endpoint is registered; no within-experiment multiplicity correction is required. RMSE, bias, correlation and model-vs-0.5 metrics are descriptive only and receive no confirmatory p-values.

leakage_and_reproducibility: Verify Q80 C0 and Q7 source archive identities and Q7 exact-prefix provenance.
Verify all 3,286 Q7 targets match Q80 C0 target date, cutoff, actual quintet, split and target index.
For each target, use exactly the previous 50 Q80 target rows and previous 50 Q7 target outcomes.
Mutating current/future Q80 or Q7 outcomes must not change current predictors.
Discovery predictions are expanding prequential; Validation/Blind coefficients are frozen at Discovery end.
No Validation or Blind outcomes may enter coefficient fitting or hyperparameter selection.
Deterministic model fitting, block inference, ledger ordering and byte-identical replay.
interpretation: The outcome is the retrospective rank quality of a fixed formula universe, not the winning quintet itself. A positive result would only justify an independent prospective shadow replication; historical Blind OOS is exposed by prior SONAR research and is not virgin evidence.
decision_rule: Flag for independent prospective replication only if the primary Blind OOS MAE improvement is at least 0.005 and the one-sided block sign-flip p-value is below 0.05. No engine promotion, forecast selection or canonical archive mutation.
